review: HTML differs only by the appended scoped CSS/script include.
Central module JavaScript differs only by the editor cache version URL.
Existing index, login, role permissions and database workflow are unchanged.
No polling, subtree observers, fetch requests or remote typing dependencies in the new script.
At most five suggestions, 90ms debounce, bounded dictionaries and maximum 48-character conversion token.
Screen-only premium CSS, with typing controls explicitly hidden in print.
Text insertion uses textContent/setRangeText; suggestion source validated before replacement.
IME, saving locks, stale voice results, hidden-page and disposal cleanup reviewed.

limitations: Mock RPC responses; no production database or live login was accessed.
Optional pre-existing fflate and paper-typography assets were not available in the retrieved patches. Import/typography features were not changed or fully tested.
Voice used mocked speech events. No physical microphone test.
Print CSS and preview consistency tested. No physical printer test.
Short synthetic performance test, not an all-day soak test.
